title: Markets
name: Markets
description: A price chart for one stock, index, currency or crypto: the price now, the change over the period, and the line — today, this week, a month, six months or a year.
whenToUse: When the user wants to SEE or ASK how a stock, share, market index, currency pair or crypto is doing — its price or its chart: «what's Apple's stock price», «show me a chart of Apple stock», «how is the Nasdaq today», «Tesla over the last month», «bitcoin this year».
usage: To chart something use 'show' with 'symbol' — a ticker (AAPL, ^IXIC, BTC-USD, EURUSD=X) or just the name ('Apple', 'Nasdaq', 'bitcoin'): it is looked up — and 'range' (1d = today, 5d = this week, 1mo = last month, 6mo, 1y, 5y; default 1d). 'range' changes the PERIOD of the chart already on screen («show me the last month instead»). 'refresh' updates it. Both return the name, price, currency and change: say them in one short sentence. It only shows prices; it never buys or sells.

show.desc: SHOWS the price and chart of a stock, index, currency or crypto («Apple's stock price», «how is the Nasdaq»): by ticker or name, over a period (1d · 5d · 1mo · 3mo · 6mo · 1y · 5y)

payload.symbol: ticker or name, e.g. AAPL or Apple

range.desc: CHANGES THE PERIOD of the chart on screen («the last month instead», «show me the whole year», «just today»)

refresh.desc: updates the chart on screen with the latest price
